name: Burbank-Glendale-Pasadena Regional Housing Trust - Jul 08, 2026
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  BURBANK-GLENDALE-PASADENA REGIONAL HOUSING TRUST

  WEDNESDAY, JULY 8, 2026 - 4:00 P.M.

  MEETING WILL BE HELD IN-PERSON & VIRTUALLY
  BURBANK CITY HALL
  275 EAST OLIVE AVENUE, BURBANK CA, 91502

  JESS RIVAS  NIKKI PEREZ  DAN BROTMAN
  Chair  Vice Chair  Director

Except as otherwise provided by law, no action shall be taken on any item not appearing on the agenda. When
addressing the Burbank-Glendale-Pasadena Regional Housing Trust (Trust), please state your name (or
pseudonym) for the record prior to providing your comments. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities
Act, those requiring accommodation or services of an interpreter for this meeting should notify the Assistant Trust
Manager, Zaire Marin, at zaire.marin@weareharris.com. Requests received less than 72 hours in advance will
still receive every effort to be reasonably fulfilled within the time provided.

Instructions for Public Comments: This agenda contains a brief general description of each item to be considered.
The Burbank-Glendale- Pasadena Regional Housing Trust encourages public participation. For those wishing to
make public comments on agenda and non-agenda items, but within the Trust’s subject matter jurisdiction, you
may submit written comments via email or provide a verbal comment by participating in-person or through the
available virtual option.

1. Written Comments (Email): If you wish to submit written public comments to be distributed to the Trust
  Directors prior to or during the meeting, please submit these materials via email to the Assistant Trust
  Manager, Zaire Marin, at zaire.marin@weareharris.com at least one (1) hour prior to the scheduled meeting
  time. Please indicate in the Subject Line of the email “FOR PUBLIC COMMENT.” If you wish to comment
  on a specific agenda item, please identify the item in your email. Emailed public comments will be added to
  the record and will be part of the recorded meeting minutes. Written public comments may include, but are
  not limited to letters, reports, and presentations.
2. Verbal Comments (In Person): If you would like to make a public comment at the Board meeting location,
  please fill out a public comment card. Comment cards will be available at the entrance to the meeting room.

  Page 1 of 3
 3. Verbal Comments (Teams): If you would like to participate by teleconference from a private location, please
  email the Assistant Trust Manager, Zaire Marin, at zaire.marin@weareharris.com to request an attendee
  Teams link at least 24 hours (one day) before the meeting. Through Teams, you may provide a verbal comment
  by using the web interface “Raise Hand” feature when the agenda item upon which you wish to speak is to be
  considered. You will then be called upon to provide your verbal comments.

  All supporting documentation is available for public review online at:
  https://www.bgphousingtrust.org/ and posted at Burbank City Hall located at
  275 East Olive Avenue, Burbank, CA 91502 during regular business hours,
  8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday.

  A GENDA | B URBANK –G LENDALE –P ASADENA –R EGIONAL H OUSING T RUST , J ULY 8, 2026 - P AGE 2
 CALL TO ORDER / ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
At this time, members of the public may address the Trust on any matter not on the agenda but within the
jurisdiction of the Trust. The Trust or Chair may limit the length of time each individual may have to address the
Trust.

CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS:

1. Approve Burbank-Glendale-Pasadena Regional Housing Trust minutes for the May 6, 2026, Board meeting.

  Recommended Action: Approve Burbank-Glendale-Pasadena Regional Housing Trust minutes for the
  May 6, 2026, Board meeting.

2. Receive and file an update regarding the City of Burbank’s request for $3,450,000 for the Homeless Solutions
  Center.

PRESENTATION

3. Presentation regarding the Trust CalHome First-Time Homebuyer Mortgage Assistance Program.

DISCUSSION/ACTION ITEMS:
At this time, members of the public in attendance may ask the Board to be heard on the following items as those
items are called.

4. Adopt Resolution 26-4 Adopting the Trust Fiscal Year 2026-27 Measure A Funding Budget.

  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 26-4 Adopting the Trust Fiscal Year 2026-27 Measure A Funding
  Budget.

TRUST MANAGER REPORT:

5. Oral Report from the Trust Manager

DIRECTOR COMMENTS:

ADJOURNMENT:

Meeting Adjourned at:

Next Regular Meeting:

September 2, 2026 (Glendale City Hall)
